items.t: Coolant leaks from the expansion tank and hoses
items.job: Replace coolant expansion tank or leaking hose, then bleed the system
items.note: A coolant reservoir replacement on the related 228i Gran Coupe runs about $419-$498 at RepairPal.

items.t: Oil leaks from the valve cover gasket
items.job: Replace valve cover gasket (or oil filter housing gasket)
items.note: If the plastic valve cover itself is cracked, the cover must be replaced and parts cost more.

items.t: Engine using oil between services
items.job: Oil consumption test and leak inspection
items.note: Fixing worn rings or valve seals is major engine work that costs far more.

items.t: Timing chain rattle on cold start
items.job: Replace timing chain tensioner (chain and guides if worn)
items.note: A tensioner alone is a small job; a full chain and guide replacement means removing the transmission on this engine.

items.t: Charge pipe cracks or pops off on the M35i
items.job: Replace turbo charge pipe

items.t: Clunk or droning from worn engine mounts
items.job: Replace engine mount or torque link

items.t: Hesitation or jerky shifts at low speed
items.job: Transmission software update or fluid service

items.t: Water in the front footwell from the A/C drain
items.job: Clear A/C condensate drain, dry carpet and check for damage

items.t: Side mirror fault that disables windows
items.job: Replace outside mirror glass or mirror electronics

items.t: Increased battery drain warning
items.job: Software update or 12-volt AGM battery replacement and registration
items.note: Software fixes are usually free under warranty; a battery is needed only if it tests weak.

items.t: Brake pads and rotors wear out early
items.job: Front brake pads, rotors and wear sensor

items.t: Knocking from worn front control arm bushings
items.job: Replace front lower control arms or bushings, plus alignment

items.t: Central screen freezes or restarts
items.job: iDrive software update

items.t: Rear light housings work loose and clack
items.job: Re-secure or replace rear light housing mounts
items.note: BMW extended the warranty on these housings to 10 years with no mileage limit.

items.t: Check engine light or rough running after a cold start
items.job: Diagnose codes and apply engine software update

items.t: Tailgate opens on its own or groans
items.job: Tailgate software update or actuator replacement

items.t: Crankshaft sensor software can stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair

items.t: Steering tie rods can wear and break (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair

items.t: Rollover sensor fault can stop airbags firing (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair

items.t: Passenger seat belt retractor may release too early (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair

items.t: Integrated brake system can lose power assist (recalls)
items.job: Dealer recall repair

items.t: Brake module motor welds can break (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair

items.t: Front seat belt retractors may not hold (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair

items.t: Rear seat belts may not lock (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair

items.t: Infotainment glitches and CarPlay audio dropouts
items.job: iDrive software update

items.t: Weak cabin heat in cold weather
items.job: Heater and climate system diagnosis
items.note: Usually covered under the new-car warranty on these years.

items.t: Rear camera sometimes does not turn on
items.job: Camera and parking sensor diagnosis and software update
items.note: Usually covered under the new-car warranty on these years.
